rules.allocation: per origin stratum in ['phone', 'camera']: n_mono/n_near each, capped at available
rules.eligibility: one image row per asset (latest frame), derived infer-v1 ok, privacy.filter_items(provider=claude), not in the caption-audit sample, not in an earlier colour set, nor in either's capture groups, one per capture group
rules.near: colour_guess unknown, colour with chroma_p95 < 45.0, or mono with chroma_p95 >= 2.0
rules.reference: opus-v2 or opus-api-v2 label records (label-v2; colour_guess never shown), colour_class with confidence >= 0.5
rules.split: dev/test by seeded sha256 of the capture group (group_id or asset_id), 50/50
